title: Software Engineer II
diff: document intelligence · AI layer, frontend lead

changes.text: Built the AI layer of an internal document intelligence platform, covering LLM extraction, user-defined models and retrieval workflows; cut manual document review by 60%.
Led the frontend and designed role- and group-based access control from scratch, so departments with different data-access rules could work on one platform; adopted by 20+ business teams.

Designed model routing that sends each document to a self-hosted model or a hosted LLM API based on its sensitivity, keeping restricted content on internal infrastructure while meeting accuracy targets.
Rebuilt the team's CI/CD pipeline and introduced React Testing Library and Vitest suites: 40% shorter release cycles, 35% fewer production hotfixes and 60% less manual testing.

title: Engineering drawing extraction, proof of concept
summary: Forward-deployed with the business owners, owned end to end from requirements to a working proof of concept.

changes.text: Gathered requirements directly with the business owners and independently researched DIN and ISO drawing standards, so the pipeline could read decades-old, often German-language scans.
Designed and built an extraction harness with Python, FastAPI and Azure OpenAI that captures drawing attributes, until now read by hand, at 99% accuracy.
Resolved 10+ high-priority production bugs on a business-critical enterprise application, cutting user-reported issues by 45%.
Led pre-audit security hardening across internal applications; every application passed the security review.
Reworked operations scheduling workflows, improving throughput by 30%.
